title: The Visitor — Demo
description: A two-night slice of the full game: three visitors, two outcomes, one threshold.

nights.title: Night 1: The Threshold
nights.subtitle: Demo — First Knock
nights.briefing: The fog takes the road. Two people are at the checkpoint door before midnight. Let the right ones in; the wrong one ends the demo early.
nights.environmental_hazard: Ground fog reduces the view through the inspection window.

day_phase_events.summary: Viktor checks the lock. Vera counts cans. The radio will not hold a station.
day_phase_events.shelter_event: A short tutorial in the house; the front door is the only way out.

dialogue_highlights.speaker: Viktor
dialogue_highlights.text: Five minutes at the door. If it looks wrong, it is wrong.

dialogue_highlights.speaker: Vera
dialogue_highlights.text: And if it looks right, look again.

scripted_events.description: Marcus Vane is the first knock. He teaches the inspection loop.

nights.title: Night 2: The Last Dusk
nights.subtitle: Demo — Final Verdict
nights.briefing: Three knocks before dawn. The demo ends when the road goes quiet.
nights.environmental_hazard: The generator is low; the porch light stutters.

day_phase_events.summary: The shelter waits for daylight. No one sleeps.
day_phase_events.shelter_event: The final night of the demo. Every decision is counted.

dialogue_highlights.speaker: Vera
dialogue_highlights.text: If the road clears, we will know we did.

ending_01_gatekeeper.title: The Gatekeeper
ending_01_gatekeeper.subtitle: Demo — The Line Held
ending_01_gatekeeper.summary: You held the line for two nights. No infected crossed the threshold, and the shelter still has a morning.
ending_01_gatekeeper.epilogue: At dawn the fog lifts just enough to see the road. Viktor opens the inner door. Vera puts a cup in your hand. The demo ends here; in the full game, the road goes on for five more nights.

ending_02_pariah.title: The Pariah
ending_02_pariah.subtitle: Demo — The Door Opened
ending_02_pariah.summary: Something crossed the threshold that should not have. The shelter's trust did not survive the night.
ending_02_pariah.epilogue: At 03:40 the first scream comes from the bunks. By dawn the checkpoint is quiet for the wrong reason. The demo ends here; the full game gives you five more nights to live with it.
